entities.summary: Stomu Yamashta (b. 1947-03-15, Kyoto) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kyoto and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
